rhea: Kickoff: 'Ignite StarterKit' launch. Scope: tiny OSS refapp (chat+embeds), short how-to, reproducible bench kit, 25-30m webinar, gated starter-playbook. Target: 600 signups, 120 live attendees.

tony: Dates?

rhea: Publish June 3, webinar June 18. Drafts due May 20.

kesha: Bench plan: cpu | small-gpu | q4 quant. I'll deliver p50/p95, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens. Need canonical prompts (support convo, doc summary, 300-512 token trims).

omar: Repo: two services (api, demo), docker + deploy button, README with expected metrics and quickstart <10 lines. I'll add GH Action smoke bench.

tony: Webinar format: 6-min demo video, 10-min bench walkthrough, 8-min ops tips (caching, batching), then Q. Promo clips: 20s + 45s.

rhea: Messaging: primary = "forkable inference starter for engineers". Social TL;DR: one sentence + emoji. UTMs: campaign=ignite-starter, src=(webinar|blog|tweet).

kesha: I'll attach raw CSV and a small plot in the blog and include a "how we measured" appendix with commands.

omar: Lead form: name, email, role, company size, checkbox "Interested in Dedicated" -> AE routing. I'll wire HubSpot.

launch-bot: Checklist: https://ok.redwood/launch/ignite-starter (repo, tutorial, bench, slides, gated pdf, form).

rhea: Owners: rhea (launch), omar (repo+infra), kesha (bench), tony (slides+promo). Next sync May 8 9am PT. Drop blockers here. :rocket:
